SELECT b.id, b.version_id, b.ocr_task_id, b.status, b.engine_version, b.detection_preview_url, b.detection_preview_content_type, b.detection_preview_size, b.detection_preview_sha256, b.detection_preview_width, b.detection_preview_height, b.field_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM ocr_binding b JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = b.version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN archive_record ar ON ar.id = d.archive_record_id AND ar.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN employee e ON e.id = ar.employee_id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE b.id = #{id}
AND 1 = 1 AND e.department_id = #{departmentId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} AND 1 = 0
